flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_management/suspension/HstManagementServiceImpl (apply-hst); ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/hstreport/{services/HstReportServiceImpl,helpers/HstReportHelper} (monthly queue + comparison report), schedulers/{MonthlyReportJobsScheduler,DailyReportJobsScheduler}, workflows/agencies/mha/{upload,download}/..., workflows/datahiveuenfin/..., crud/ocmsizdb/{OcmsAdhocNroTemp,OcmsTempUncHstAddr}; cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code for this story's steps
note: Story status is 'Requirement given - Gen flow'. The story does not use the word HST; mapping 'special indicator' to HST (ocms_hst + TS-HST) is inferred from the OCMS 20 comments in the code and the siblings OCMS20.18-20.20. The re-check against the agencies exists, but as a fixed monthly cron for all HST IDs (1st of the month, 08:30), not every X days per ID from the indicator date, and no parameter can be changed. The NRIC route through the MHA enquiry file is enabled in the prod properties; the FIN/UEN route through DataHive is switched off (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false). 'ICA' and 'DOS' do not exist as named integrations: DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo, and whether MHA = ICA cannot verify from repo. The address comparison exists only in an Excel report; all HST report queries depend on the query_reason column, which no code writes (the entity does not have it), and on report_generated, which is never reset, so whether the report is populated in a real environment cannot verify from repo. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-126 (Closed, HST FIN stored as id_type N), OCMS-DF-2026-125 (Closed, TS-HST in MHA file), OCMS-DF-2026-094 (Closed, PS notices also got TS-HST). Real server property values cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: applying the indicator, the monthly queue to MHA, address storage and the comparison report exist. Do not claim the configurable X-day interval, the DOS/FIN/UEN route (switched off in the prod properties), or the ICA/DOS interface names. Confirm with the team whether query_reason/report_generated are filled in the DB.

steps.step: The special indicator (TS-HST) has already been applied to all outstanding notices under the offender ID
steps.detail: Mapping 'special indicator' to HST (an ocms_hst row plus a TS-HST suspension) is inferred from the OCMS 20 comments in the code, not from the story. applyHstSuspension (POST /v1/apply-hst) creates the ocms_hst row (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:307-322), finds all notices with offender_indicator='Y' by ID (:326-327), applies TS-HST per notice through tsHelper.processTS (:492-500) and skips notices with an active PS (:338-340). This is a staff action (main scope of OCMS20.18); here it is only the precondition. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-094 (Closed) once reported PS notices also getting TS-HST; the current code skips active PS.

steps.step: OCMS sends the IDs every X days (configurable parameter), counted from the date the indicator was applied
steps.detail: queueHstIdsForMonthlyCheck puts ALL ocms_hst rows into ocms_adhoc_nro_temp without looking at the indicator date (HstReportServiceImpl.java:152-196). It is triggered by MonthlyReportJobsScheduler (job 'HST Monthly Query', MonthlyReportJobsScheduler.java:76) on the 1st of each month at 08:30: cron.monthlyreport.schedule=0 30 8 1 * ?, enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:275-276). So the schedule is a fixed monthly run for all IDs, not X days per ID from the indicator date, and no parameter is editable by the user. The adhoc table only holds id_no and id_type (OcmsAdhocNroTemp.java:34-45), with no indicator date. The only day-count in the HST area is cron.hst.looping.days.before.revival=7 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:53) for revival looping, not a check interval; that looping job itself is commented out at ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:121. The real server value cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: NRICs are sent to ICA through the MHA enquiry file and results are fetched back
steps.detail: MhaNricUploadJob calls queryUnclaimedAndHstData (MhaNricUploadJob.java:160), which reads ocms_adhoc_nro_temp filtered on idType='N' only (MhaNricDataHelper.java:442-448), then merges it into the MHA enquiry file (:165). Schedule Monday-Saturday 09:00, 14:00, 21:00, enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). The channel in the code is MHA for NRIC; 'ICA' as a named interface does not exist in the repo, so whether MHA is the ICA route the story means cannot verify from repo, and neither can the SFTP delivery or the server property values. Adhoc rows are not deleted by the upload (commented-out TODO, MhaNricUploadJob.java:257-259); they are removed by the daily Unclaimed Batch Data Report job (UnclaimedReportHelper.java:488-496) for ids already present in ocms_temp_unc_hst_addr. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-126 (Closed): HST FIN IDs used to be stored as id_type N (hardcoded) and went into the MHA file; now idType comes from the request (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:310). OCMS-DF-2026-125 (Closed): TS-HST notices went into the main MHA file; the June 2026 ticket remark says the MHA cron was not yet on in PRD, while the prod properties now say enabled=true (server value cannot verify).

steps.step: FIN/UEN IDs are sent to DOS and the registered address is received
steps.detail: Adhoc rows with idType F (FIN) and B (UEN) are read by DataHiveUenFinService.queryAdhocNroTempData (DataHiveUenFinService.java:325-336) and processed by DataHiveUenFinJob (DataHiveUenFinJob.java:197) through DataHive. The job is skipped when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:104); in the prod properties it is false with the comment 'Keep disabled in PROD until DataHive view names are verified' (cron-schedules-prod.properties:51-52). So execution of this step is switched off by repo config; the real server value cannot verify from repo. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo: there is no integration named DOS in the backend.

steps.step: OCMS receives the registered address from ICA/DOS and stores it for comparison
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadJob processes the response file (Monday-Saturday 11:30, 16:30, 23:30, enabled=true, cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120) and calls storeUncHstResults (MhaNricDownloadJob.java:686-695). That method loads all adhoc ids (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:3146-3160), skips responses that are not adhoc (:3190), and upserts the address into ocms_temp_unc_hst_addr with type_of_address 'mha_reg' (:3212-3260). Gap: one row per id_no (existingByIdNo, :3212), so the previous cycle's result is overwritten; the entity has no query_reason/report_generated (OcmsTempUncHstAddr.java:36-114) and the upsert does not set query_reason, although UNC and HST adhoc rows share the same table and every HST report query filters on query_reason='HST'. Who fills them (DB default/trigger) cannot verify from repo. Only the NRIC/MHA route is active; see the previous step for FIN/UEN.

steps.step: OCMS checks whether the received registered address differs from the address OCMS holds
steps.detail: The comparison only lives in a report. fetchHstDataWithAddressComparison joins ocms_hst with ocms_temp_unc_hst_addr (HstReportHelper.java:381-406); old and new addresses are built into text and compared with equals (:465-472) for the 'Address Changed' column; the getAddressesChanged statistic only compares street_name and postal_code (:650-657). It runs in the Daily Report job at 08:00 (cron.dailyreport.schedule=0 0 8 * * ?, enabled=true, cron-schedules-prod.properties:255-256; DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:99). Gap: the result is not stored as a per-ID flag and this job does not update ocms_hst; the text comparison can give a false 'Yes' when floor/unit is empty on one side (data cannot be checked from the repo). The report queries filter on query_reason='HST' (:405) and report_generated (:406), but no code fills query_reason: the OcmsTempUncHstAddr entity has neither query_reason nor report_generated (OcmsTempUncHstAddr.java:36-114) and the MHA upsert does not set them (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:3212-3260); report_generated is only set to 'Y' by the report job. Whether a DB default/trigger fills them cannot verify from repo; if empty, the HST report is empty. After the first report, report_generated is set to 'Y' (HstReportHelper.java:612-619) and later upserts do not reset it, so next month's result for the same ID may not reach the report (unless a trigger exists, cannot verify).
